about: ws-backtest --self-test only: a row whose check sleeps (must report TIMEOUT under --timeout 2, its tree killed) and one that finishes at once (must PASS).

rows.command: echo selftest tail line 1; echo selftest tail line 2; echo selftest tail line 3; bash -c 'exec -a ws-backtest-selftest-sleeper sleep 60' & sleep 60; echo sleeper: OK

rows.check: a check that answers at once
